import struct

class Student:
    def __init__(self, roll=0, name="", marks=0.0):
        self.roll = roll
        self.name = name[:20]  # Truncate to 20 chars
        self.marks = marks
    
    def input(self):
        parts = input().split()
        self.roll = int(parts[0])
        # Name can have spaces, so join the middle parts and take up to 20 chars
        name_parts = parts[1:-1]
        marks_part = parts[-1]
        if name_parts:
            self.name = " ".join(name_parts)[:20]
        else:
            self.name = ""
        self.marks = float(marks_part)
    
    def display(self):
        print(f"Roll: {self.roll}")
        print(f"Name: {self.name}")
        print(f"Marks: {int(self.marks) if self.marks == int(self.marks) else self.marks}")
    
    def pack(self):
        # Pack into binary format: int, 20 chars, float
        name_bytes = self.name.encode('utf-8')[:20]
        name_bytes = name_bytes.ljust(20, b'\x00')
        return struct.pack('i', self.roll) + name_bytes + struct.pack('f', self.marks)
    
    @classmethod
    def unpack(cls, data):
        roll = struct.unpack('i', data[:4])[0]
        name_bytes = data[4:24]
        name = name_bytes.rstrip(b'\x00').decode('utf-8')
        marks = struct.unpack('f', data[24:])[0]
        return cls(roll, name, marks)

def main():
    import os
    
    n = int(input().strip())
    
    students = []
    for _ in range(n):
        s = Student()
        s.input()
        students.append(s)
    
    filename = "students.dat"
    with open(filename, "wb") as f:
        for s in students:
            f.write(s.pack())
    
    record_number = int(input().strip())
    new_marks = float(input().strip())
    
    record_size = 4 + 20 + 4  # int + 20 chars + float
    
    with open(filename, "rb") as f:
        if 1 <= record_number <= n:
            f.seek((record_number - 1) * record_size)
            data = f.read(record_size)
            if len(data) == record_size:
                s = Student.unpack(data)
                s.marks = new_marks
                f.seek((record_number - 1) * record_size)
                f.write(s.pack())
                print("Record Updated Successfully")
                print("Updated Record:")
                s.display()
        else:
            print("Record not found")
    
    # Clean up
    if os.path.exists(filename):
        os.remove(filename)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
